projects.name: Sudarshan
projects.tagline: Android banking malware sandbox and threat intelligence platform
projects.summary: Sudarshan analyses suspicious Android banking apps in a Frida sandbox, captures the command-and-control servers they talk to, and gives each one a deterministic 0–100 risk score.
body: Fake banking apps copy the real app's look, ask for the same PIN and drain the account within minutes. Families like Drinik, Xenomorph, SOVA, Anubis, Cerberus, Hydra, Octo and Teabot abuse a single Accessibility permission to read the screen, draw a fake login over the real app and swallow OTP messages. A fresh build usually gets 0 detections on VirusTotal, so a bank's fraud analyst learns nothing useful from antivirus alone.

Sudarshan takes a suspicious APK, decompiles and repairs it, runs it in a Frida-instrumented Android sandbox, captures the C2 servers it contacts, checks every indicator against threat intelligence feeds and produces a reproducible risk score. A Gemini assistant then answers analyst questions using only the evidence collected for that case.
highlights: Decompiles APKs with Androguard, APKTool and JADX, and repairs the malformed ZIP and AndroidManifest headers malware authors use to crash analysis tools
Live Frida hooks on Accessibility Services, overlay APIs (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW) and SMS receivers, with a UI agent that clicks through prompts and anti-emulation tricks
A mitmproxy sidecar captures C2 domains, IPs and beacons, cross-checked against AlienVault OTX, AbuseIPDB and VirusTotal and mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
Deterministic Banking Fraud & Cyber Threat Index (BFCI): every score is auditable and reproducible
Built on one rule: “The Engine Decides, The AI Explains.” The assistant cites case evidence and cannot change the score
projects.image_alt: Sudarshan dashboard listing analysed Android banking malware cases

projects.name: NarraReel
projects.tagline: Turn your script into a Reel or Short with your own voice and word-synced captions
projects.summary: NarraReel turns a script you wrote into a finished Reel, Short or YouTube video, narrated in a free AI voice or your own cloned voice, cut to the exact second, with word-by-word animated captions.
body: Most faceless videos get skipped in the first two seconds: the voice sounds flat, the captions are a wall of text, and the clip runs longer than the format allows. NarraReel fixes those three things for the script you already wrote. It does not generate your content for you.
It runs on your own computer, with no account, no API key and no watermark.
highlights: Clone your voice from about 30 seconds of audio, then set the delivery anywhere from calm to hype
Exact length: ask for 60 seconds and get 60 seconds, by stretching the pauses between sentences first
Ten caption presets rendered from the same word timings, plus a transparent overlay export for your editor
Web app in the browser and a command-line interface
projects.image_alt: NarraReel caption styles with each word highlighted as it is spoken

projects.name: IPDS: Intelligent Pothole Detection System
projects.tagline: Real-time pothole detection with YOLOv8, dual ESP32 and accelerometer fusion
projects.summary: A low-cost dual-ESP32 and YOLOv8 rig that detects potholes in real time, tracks them, confirms each one with an accelerometer, and logs it with a severity score, GPS position and timestamp.
body: Most pothole projects stop at drawing a box on an image. IPDS goes all the way from the camera to a geo-tagged, severity-ranked maintenance log. A pothole is logged only when the camera sees it and the car feels it.
The work is written up as a research preprint, “Real-Time Pothole Detection Based on Vision-Dominant Sensor Fusion and Dual ESP32 Architecture”, published on Zenodo.
highlights: YOLOv8m fine-tuned for potholes, reaching mAP@0.5 of 81.7%
SORT tracking (Kalman filter and Hungarian matching) gives every pothole one stable ID, so it is counted once
An MPU6050 accelerometer burst confirms the impact before anything is logged
CSV log with GPS, RTC timestamp, a 0–1 severity score and an annotated video
Custom sensor-node PCB designed in KiCad, plus a Wokwi simulation and a Colab quick start

projects.name: Arivo
projects.tagline: AI finance controller that keeps AI inside deterministic accounting rules
projects.summary: Arivo (repository: Aviro) is an invariant-governed AI finance controller. It puts deterministic accounting rules around probabilistic AI, so no money moves without authorisation and nothing is auto-matched by mistake.
body: “Know where every rupee went, or know exactly why you don't.” In Arivo, AI investigates, rules verify, controls protect and humans resolve ambiguity.

In the flagship safety scenario, Gemini recommends matching a ₹6,00,000 payment with 97% confidence, and Arivo's Control Gate vetoes the match and holds the money in review because the evidence does not meet the rules.
highlights: Guarantees zero unauthorised capital movement and zero false auto-matches
Deterministic waterfall matching with a Control Gate that can veto AI recommendations
Evidence drawer and a grounded “Ask Arivo” copilot
Benchmark suite and backend tests included

projects.name: GramDrishti
projects.tagline: Satellite and AI climate intelligence for Indian villages
projects.summary: GramDrishti monitors Indian villages using satellite imagery and geospatial data. It tracks water, vegetation, land cover and climate to produce a Village Health Score and local-language recommendations for Gram Panchayats, farmers and NGOs.
body: Climate risks like drought, falling groundwater and vegetation loss build up slowly, and village bodies rarely have the data to see them early. GramDrishti turns free satellite data into a simple score and clear advice in the local language, so action can start before the damage is done.
Built with my teammate Shweta Patil for HackVenture 2026, a national hackathon by Sponfest, where it won 1st place in the Agritech domain.
highlights: Satellite NDVI and NDWI monitoring of vegetation and water
Village Health Score combining water, vegetation, land cover and climate
Multilingual AI recommendations for Gram Panchayats, farmers and NGOs
Dashboards for early climate-risk detection

projects.name: Bhumi
projects.tagline: Crop health investigation from satellite imagery with tamper-evident field records
projects.summary: Satellites flag the field. Bhumi says why, names the one check that settles it, and seals the evidence so nobody can quietly change it later.
body: Sentinel-2 photographs every field on Earth about every five days for free, but a red patch is not a diagnosis. It could be cloud, a harvest on schedule, a district-wide heatwave or a failing drip line on one farm. Field officers who look after hundreds of farms cannot visit every alert, so they stop trusting the alerts.

Monitoring records are also easy to bend: kept in an ordinary database, they can be edited after the fact or claimed twice. Bhumi uses satellite imagery, weather data and verifiable field records to detect crop stress, identify probable causes and recommend the next best field check, and it seals the evidence.
highlights: Runs on real Sentinel-2 imagery and Open-Meteo weather for 150 fields in Niphad, Nashik (Maharashtra)
Diagnoses likely causes instead of just flagging lost greenness
Recommends the single field check that settles each case
Tamper-evident evidence ledger for monitoring and verification schemes

projects.name: Smaran
projects.tagline: Offline-first memory and intelligence for edge fleets, built on Qdrant Edge
projects.summary: Smaran is offline-first memory and intelligence for edge fleets. It keeps working when the network vanishes, seals private notes on-device, and uses version vectors to flag clashing field reports instead of silently dropping one.
body: Picture two maintenance technicians, or two rovers, sent into a network dead zone: a steel-reinforced basement, a remote mine, another planet. Each keeps working and writing reports. When they reconnect, most systems keep the last write and lose the other. Smaran flags the conflict instead.
Built on Qdrant Edge on every device and Qdrant Server as the fleet hub.
highlights: Local vector search keeps working with no network
Private notes are sealed on-device by construction
Mathematical version vectors detect and surface conflicting reports
Mission-control dashboard, measured benchmarks and CI

projects.name: Smart Traffic Flow Analyzer
projects.tagline: Traffic signals that adapt to live vehicle density using YOLOv8 and ESP32
projects.summary: A real-time traffic signal system that counts vehicles with YOLOv8 and SORT and changes green-light timing on the fly based on traffic density, with an ESP32 driving the signal display.
body: Conventional traffic signals run on fixed timing plans that ignore real-time traffic. That wastes green time when roads are empty and causes congestion when they are full.
This system detects and tracks vehicles in a region of interest, averages density over a 5-second sliding window and adjusts the remaining green phase, within safe minimum and maximum bounds.
highlights: Vehicle detection and tracking with YOLOv8 and SORT
Dynamic green time from a 5-second sliding average of vehicle density
Safety constraints keep green time within a configured range (for example 30–90 seconds)
Signal phase and countdown sent to an ESP32 over TCP for physical LEDs

projects.name: FieldDx
projects.tagline: AI crop diagnostics that tell field officers which farms to visit first
projects.summary: FieldDx uses satellite imagery to identify crop health changes, evaluate likely causes, rule out alternatives and recommend the most cost-effective field check to verify the diagnosis.
body: A field officer in Nashik's grape and onion belt might see 68 fields that lost green in three weeks, with time to visit perhaps fifteen. Some of that red is a hazy satellite pass, some is a harvest on schedule, and many are one neighbourhood-wide dry spell. Somewhere in there is the plot where disease is actually spreading.
FieldDx triages those alerts so the officer's day goes to the farms that need it.
highlights: Detects crop health changes from satellite imagery
Weighs likely causes and rules out alternatives such as cloud, harvest and regional weather
Recommends the cheapest field check that confirms the diagnosis
Designed India-first for smallholder farms

projects.name: InsureRoute
projects.tagline: Supply-chain intelligence with weather-aware rerouting and dynamic insurance pricing
projects.summary: InsureRoute connects predictive routing with financial hedging: it watches real-time weather, predicts transit disruptions, reroutes shipments and prices cargo insurance by actual route risk.
body: Global logistics is fragile and cargo insurance is rigid. Alternate routes are found only after a delay happens, and shippers pay the same premium whether the truck crosses a clear highway or a flooded monsoon zone.
InsureRoute brings the scattered data together into one view for risk managers.
highlights: Isolation Forest anomaly detection over weather severity, historical delays and vehicle telemetry
Algorithmic rerouting before disruptions hit
Dynamic, actuarial pricing of cargo risk

projects.name: Nova
projects.tagline: Autonomous household commerce agent with a deterministic safety gate
projects.summary: Nova is an autonomous household commerce agent: it tracks household consumption, reorders essentials before they run out, and deliberately refuses to spend when stock is healthy.
body: Keeping track of household inventory and small daily purchases is an invisible, constant burden. Nova takes it over while keeping spending safe.
The agent runtime is separated from a pre-commit safety gate, so probabilistic reasoning never moves money on its own.
highlights: Predictive restock, for example reordering milk based on live consumption rate
Intelligent restraint: chooses to do nothing when pantry stock is healthy
Deterministic safety gate checks every order before it is placed

projects.name: Kounter
projects.tagline: Offline-first shop-audit concept for India's small shops, built for the iQOO 15
projects.summary: Kounter (हर माल गिना हुआ, every item counted) is an offline-first shop-audit concept that turns the iQOO 15's sensors into a delivery counter, expiry gate, freezer remote and Hindi voice assistant for small shops.
body: Designed with my team HoloTrio for the iQOO 15, focused on productivity for small shopkeepers.
The repository is a design and interactive prototype: a scroll-driven 3D showcase website plus the engineering specification for the Android app.
highlights: Delivery counting, expiry checks and freezer control from one phone
Hindi voice assistant for shopkeepers
Works offline-first
Showcase site with a scroll-driven 3D phone, GSAP, Lenis and a Three.js background

projects.name: KrishiSetu
projects.tagline: Blockchain-based agricultural supply chain with farm-to-table traceability
projects.summary: KrishiSetu is an agricultural supply chain management system that uses blockchain to bring transparency, traceability and trust from farm to table.
body: Built by the KrishiSahAI team, KrishiSetu tracks agricultural produce through the supply chain so every step can be traced and trusted.
highlights: Farm-to-table traceability on a blockchain ledger
Transparent records for farmers, traders and buyers
Web app built with TypeScript

projects.name: AgriAdvisor
projects.tagline: Reinforcement learning environment for safe crop pest and disease advice
projects.summary: AgriAdvisor is an OpenEnv-compatible reinforcement learning environment where AI agents learn to give safe, practical pest and disease advisories grounded in the realities of Indian smallholder farming.
body: Generic AI advice can recommend treatments a smallholder cannot afford or apply safely. AgriAdvisor rewards agents for advice that is safe and practical in real Indian farm conditions.
highlights: OpenEnv-compatible environment for training and evaluating agents
Rewards safe, practical advisories
Focused on Indian smallholder agriculture

projects.name: Plant Disease Detector
projects.tagline: Leaf-image plant disease detection with EfficientNetB3 and Streamlit
projects.summary: A deep learning system that detects plant diseases from leaf images using EfficientNetB3 and transfer learning, with an interactive Streamlit web interface.
body: Upload a photo of a leaf and the model classifies the disease, so farmers and students can get a fast first diagnosis.
highlights: EfficientNetB3 with transfer learning
Image classification across multiple plant diseases
Interactive Streamlit web app

projects.name: Electronics Component Detector
projects.tagline: Custom YOLO model that recognises Arduino and IoT components in real time
projects.summary: A custom-trained YOLO model for real-time detection and classification of common electronic components used in Arduino and IoT projects, reaching 83.8% mAP@0.5.
body: Trained on a curated dataset of components found on a typical maker's bench, the model is suited to both learning and practical use.
highlights: 83.8% mAP@0.5 on the curated dataset
Real-time detection of common Arduino and IoT parts
First custom YOLO model trained end to end

projects.name: Push-Up Counter
projects.tagline: Webcam push-up counter using pose detection in the browser
projects.summary: Push-Up Detection uses a webcam feed to detect human body keypoints and counts push-ups from body movement, entirely in the browser.
body: Pose keypoints are tracked frame by frame, and a simple movement rule counts each full push-up. A companion project, Skeleton Detection, shows the raw PoseNet skeleton.
highlights: Runs in the browser with just a webcam
Counts repetitions from body keypoint movement
Live demo on GitHub Pages

projects.name: Self Video Clip Generator
projects.tagline: Automatically cut Reels and Shorts out of long YouTube videos
projects.summary: An AI tool that automatically extracts and generates Reels and Shorts from long-form YouTube videos using a fully Python-based pipeline.
body: Give it a long video and it finds the strongest moments and exports them as short vertical clips ready to post.
highlights: End-to-end Python pipeline
Finds and cuts highlight segments automatically
Exports vertical clips for Reels and Shorts

projects.name: UniFit Health
projects.tagline: AI wellness app for college students powered by Gemini multimodal AI
projects.summary: UniFit Health is an AI-powered health and wellness tracker for college students that combines water tracking, calorie counting, steps, gym logging, posture analysis and personalised insights.
body: It uses Gemini multimodal AI to analyse food photos, posture images and daily activity, and turns them into clear recommendations.
highlights: MealScan: calories, macros and advice from a food photo
PainScan: posture and muscle-strain analysis from a photo
HydraAI hydration tracking that adapts to activity
Google sign-in and a personalised plan at onboarding

projects.name: PrepForge
projects.tagline: Adaptive placement preparation for SDE-1 and new-grad roles
projects.summary: PrepForge is an adaptive, evidence-based preparation platform for fresher (SDE-1 and new-grad) roles at big product companies.
body: It covers DSA, SQL and DBMS, OOP in C++ and Java, operating systems, networks, system design and DevOps, and adapts to what you already know.
highlights: Covers DSA, SQL, DBMS, OOP, OS, networks, system design and DevOps
Adaptive, evidence-based practice
Aimed at SDE-1 and new-grad interviews at product companies

projects.name: LeetCode Tracker
projects.tagline: Chrome extension that saves your LeetCode submissions to GitHub automatically
projects.summary: LeetCode Tracker is a Chrome extension that automatically saves your LeetCode submissions to GitHub, organises problems by topic, and gives you a dashboard of solved problems, recent activity and monthly progress.
body: It powers the LeetCodeSolved repository, where solutions are synced and organised by topic: arrays, dynamic programming, trees, graphs, SQL and more.
highlights: Automatic commit of every accepted submission
Problems organised into folders by topic
Progress dashboard with monthly activity
projects.image_alt: Solutions repository organised by LeetCode Tracker

projects.name: Smart Pot
projects.tagline: ESP32 plant monitor for temperature, humidity and soil moisture
projects.summary: A smart plant monitoring system using an ESP32 with DHT22 and soil moisture sensors to track temperature, humidity and soil moisture in real time.
body: The full circuit can be tried in a Wokwi simulation without any hardware.
highlights: Real-time temperature, humidity and soil moisture readings
ESP32 with DHT22 and soil moisture sensor
Runnable Wokwi simulation

projects.name: Smart Solar Panel
projects.tagline: Sun-tracking solar panel with Arduino, LDR sensors and a servo
projects.summary: A smart solar panel that uses an Arduino UNO, LDR sensors and a servo motor to follow the direction of sunlight and adjust the panel's angle.
body: Two light sensors compare brightness on each side, and the servo turns the panel toward the brighter side to collect more energy.
highlights: Single-axis sun tracking
LDR light comparison with servo control
Arduino UNO build

projects.name: Smart Dustbin
projects.tagline: Dustbin that sorts wet and dry waste automatically
projects.summary: A smart garbage dustbin that automatically detects and classifies waste as wet or dry using a soil moisture sensor and an ultrasonic sensor.
body: The ultrasonic sensor detects when waste arrives, and the moisture sensor decides which side it belongs to.
highlights: Automatic wet and dry waste classification
Ultrasonic presence detection
Low-cost sensor-based build
